==Notes==
* Whirlwind Attack is a single [[attack]] that can [[hit]] multiple foes. 
** When wielding a scythe, each target will only be hit once.
* The foes hit by this skill are those adjacent to the user, not the target.
** This attack will fail to hit [[kiting]] opponents, including the target, if they have moved away by the time the attack would have connected.
* The 1 second recharge prevents the skill from being easily [[spam]]med, since it will not benefit from the adrenaline it generates.
**[[Echo]] can overcome this with six adjacent foes, or with three adjacent foes when under an effect that doubles adrenaline gain such as [["For Great Justice!"]].
